prompt: Find the length of the side from $(2, 1)$ to $(2, 7)$.
hint: Compare the two points. One coordinate is the same in both, so the side runs straight along a grid line.

hints.text: Compare the two points. One coordinate is the same in both, so the side runs straight along a grid line.
Both points have $x = 2$, so the side is vertical. Its length is the difference of the $y$-values $7$ and $1$.
$7 - 1 = 6$, so the side is $6$ units long.

explanation: Both points have the same $x$-coordinate, $2$, so the side goes straight up and down.
For a vertical side, the length is how far apart the $y$-coordinates are: $|7 - 1|$.
Subtracting gives $7 - 1 = 6$, so the side is $6$ units long.
